title: kblane.path_lane classes any top-level file kb/<file> as content, not only a submodule root's gitlink
goal: kblane.path_lane classes a plain top-level file directly under the kb directory (a markdown file or the ignore file) as code while commit_paths, reading each entry's raw git mode, leaves a submodule root's gitlink (mode 160000) out of the paths it returns, with path_lane keeping its signature path_lane(path) -> str

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import kblane
lane = kblane.path_lane("kb/foo.md")
print("lane of a top-level file kb/foo.md:", lane)
sys.exit(0 if lane == "code" else 1)
